# The syntactic narrow. It finds every `process.env.X` read; it cannot know
# whether X is declared, because that answer lives in a different file. Deciding
# is `check.ts`'s job, which is what makes this a runtime rule rather than an
# `sg` one.
id: env-read
language: TypeScript
rule:
  pattern: process.env.$VAR
metadata:
  taskless:
    version: 1
    kind: runtime
    name: env-read
    check: check.ts
    match: anchor

// API_URL is read here and declared in .env, so this case is clean.
export const apiUrl = process.env.API_URL;
